The transmission method overwrites the window’s correctly represented weighting coordinates with `self._n.snapshots` via `assign_coords`. For flat multi-period builds this restores a MultiIndex instead of the flow variable’s flat tuple labels, and for models built on only a subset of network snapshots it can cause a coordinate-length mismatch. Thus, although efficiency selection uses the variable’s snapshot labels, snapshot weighting does not satisfy the criterion for every network.
